Our Story

About Mingo's Upholstery

Hi! Since 1993 I've been repairing, refinishing, reupholstering and restoring automobile and boat interiors in Ogden and much of Northern Utah.

Leather refinishing in your car, marine vinyl repair in your boat, or fixing a tear in your sofa — I do it all!

My lovely and supportive wife Christy has been here for all of it.

Serving Northern Utah Since 1993
What We Do

Our Services

🚗

Auto Interiors

Seats, door panels, dashboards, headliners. We restore your vehicle's interior to like-new condition.

⛵

Marine Vinyl

Boat seats, cushions, canvas, and covers. Built to handle sun, water, and years of use.

🛋️

Furniture Repair

Sofas, chairs, ottomans — torn, cracked, or worn — brought back to life.

🪡

Leather Refinishing

Cracked, faded, or discolored leather restored with professional-grade dyes and conditioners.

🚐

RV Interiors

Motorhome and travel trailer seating, captain's chairs, and interior panels.

📍

Mobile Service

For many services I can come to you — virtually anywhere along the Wasatch Front.
